title: World War II History
description: Key events and facts about the Second World War

questions.question: In which year did World War II begin?
questions.explanation: World War II began on September 1, 1939, when Nazi Germany invaded Poland.

questions.question: Which event brought the United States into World War II?
questions.explanation: The Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941, led to the United States entering World War II.

questions.question: What was D-Day?
questions.explanation: D-Day (June 6, 1944) was the Allied invasion of Normandy, France, which marked a turning point in the war in Europe.

questions.question: Which cities were atomic bombs dropped on?
questions.explanation: The United States dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima (August 6, 1945) and Nagasaki (August 9, 1945), leading to Japan's surrender.

questions.question: When did World War II end?
questions.explanation: World War II ended in 1945: Germany surrendered in May and Japan surrendered in September after the atomic bombings.
